title: With a Clock
label: ch:zh-with-a-clock
canDo: I can fill a short form and write a short message against a clock.

payoff.summary: Complete ZH-R98-review-final-98: one dialogue across the A1 core, where, what there is, how many, giving, can, want, too, all, why and because, after a five-field form and a short message under this book's own three-minute clock.
payoff.note: The A1 target is HSK 3.0 Level 1-aligned and project-defined (chinese/assessment-spec.md); the complete target adds independently scored productive writing, a small form and a short message. No official clock is claimed: the three-minute timer is this book's own, which keeps the lesson inside the five-minute cap. Writing is scored as its own paper, 60 of 100, never averaged against the other three (assessment-spec.md, Four-skill pass rule).
